record.interface_detail: a relayed desktop session to a computer the customer already owns; no machine is rented
record.tooling: Cua's client and relay; the customer supplies the computer
record.chaining: not a compute source; it shares a computer already in place, and the analysis assumes no local hardware, so the free tier is worth nothing as compute

limits.value: 20 remote hours a month and 2 live sessions on Free, 200 hours and 5 sessions for USD 25 a seat

record.limits_note: a remote hour is counted once for each hour with at least one live session through the relay, per calendar month UTC; it is relay time, not machine time
record.binding_note: the 20-hour relay allowance is the only meter, and it measures time on hardware the customer owns rather than a rented host.

identity_cost.detail: an account is required to use the relay; no card and no phone were read

record.reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the service relays to the customer's own computer and provides no machine of its own
record.confidence_note: the live pricing page was read on 2026-10-26 and states that Cua does not rent machines. Earlier evaluation read 'using your computers from somewhere else' as a rented Windows host; the page's own words refute that reading.

evidence.proved: 'Up to 2 live sessions and 20 remote hours a month' on the free tier against 'Up to 5 live sessions and 200 remote hours a month' at '$25 per seat a month', and 'Remote hours: time spent using your computers from somewhere else. Using a computer from itself is free.', quoted
quoted: 'Cua Spaces turns the Macs, Linux boxes and cloud VMs your team already has into shared desktops. ... You bring the computers; Cua doesn't rent them.'

record.notes: Corrected on 2026-10-26. The record had read 'using your computers from somewhere else' as a rented Windows Server host. The live page says the opposite: Cua relays to a computer the customer already owns and rents no machine. The 20 remote hours are relay hours, not a Windows host, so the record's qualifies-with-caveat verdict is withdrawn. The analysis assumes no local hardware, so the free tier is worth zero as compute.

session_cap.note: the meter is an hour with at least one live session through the relay, on a computer the customer owns

net.ports: sessions are relayed to the customer's own computer
